name: unicode
doc: Unicode character classes and case mapping.

items.name: MaxRune
items.doc: MaxRune is the largest valid Unicode code point.
items.summary: MaxRune is the largest valid Unicode code point.

items.name: IsControl
items.doc: IsControl reports whether r is a control character.
items.summary: IsControl reports whether r is a control character.

items.name: IsDigit
items.doc: IsDigit reports whether r is a decimal digit (category Nd).
items.summary: IsDigit reports whether r is a decimal digit (category Nd).

items.name: IsGraphic
items.doc: IsGraphic reports whether r is graphic: a letter, mark, number, punctuation, symbol or space.
items.summary: IsGraphic reports whether r is graphic: a letter, mark, number, punctuation, symbol or space.

items.name: IsLetter
items.doc: IsLetter reports whether r is a letter (category L).
items.summary: IsLetter reports whether r is a letter (category L).

items.name: IsLower
items.doc: IsLower reports whether r is a lower-case letter.
items.summary: IsLower reports whether r is a lower-case letter.

items.name: IsMark
items.doc: IsMark reports whether r is a combining mark (category M).
items.summary: IsMark reports whether r is a combining mark (category M).

items.name: IsNumber
items.doc: IsNumber reports whether r is a number (category N).
items.summary: IsNumber reports whether r is a number (category N).

items.name: IsPrint
items.doc: IsPrint reports whether r is printable (graphic, with ASCII space as the only space).
items.summary: IsPrint reports whether r is printable (graphic, with ASCII space as the only space).

items.name: IsPunct
items.doc: IsPunct reports whether r is punctuation (category P).
items.summary: IsPunct reports whether r is punctuation (category P).

items.name: IsSpace
items.doc: IsSpace reports whether r is white space (Unicode White_Space).
items.summary: IsSpace reports whether r is white space (Unicode White_Space).

items.name: IsSymbol
items.doc: IsSymbol reports whether r is a symbol (category S).
items.summary: IsSymbol reports whether r is a symbol (category S).

items.name: IsTitle
items.doc: IsTitle reports whether r is a title-case letter.
items.summary: IsTitle reports whether r is a title-case letter.

items.name: IsUpper
items.doc: IsUpper reports whether r is an upper-case letter.
items.summary: IsUpper reports whether r is an upper-case letter.

items.name: SimpleFold
items.doc: SimpleFold returns the next code point in the simple case-folding orbit of r.
items.summary: SimpleFold returns the next code point in the simple case-folding orbit of r.

items.name: ToLower
items.doc: ToLower maps r to lower case.
items.summary: ToLower maps r to lower case.

items.name: ToTitle
items.doc: ToTitle maps r to title case.
items.summary: ToTitle maps r to title case.

items.name: ToUpper
items.doc: ToUpper maps r to upper case.
items.summary: ToUpper maps r to upper case.
